description: Ministry of Public Services, Provincial Councils and Local Government - The Compulsory retirement age for medical officers of all grades in the Public Service will be extended to 63 years
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically amends the Minutes on Pensions regarding the compulsory retirement age for medical officers in the public service. It deals with public service retirement benefits and pension regulations, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) that cover "Pension and retirement benefits" and "Service conditions and benefits" for public sector employees.
